known_fidelity_caveats: The updated-work withdrawal paraphrases the earlier partly-attributed explanation as mainly caused. The corrected conclusion is appropriately qualified, but that historical wording is stronger than the original.

The paper draft uses phrases equivalent to larger windows do not solve accurate retrieval and position management matters more than larger windows; these are stronger than the paper's often/not necessarily qualifications.

not_claimed: Universal causal identification, natural-language entailment or exclusion of every alternative
A full path is proved by connected graph edges, valid citations or a review receipt
Task requirements inherited from compose were newly examined by this verify batch
A significant quality gain, model-independent semantic benchmark, stable token savings or end-to-end speedup
Public hosting, signed mobile installation, commercial readiness or complete RSI
privacy: No raw prompts, generated answers, user databases, source documents, provider hidden reasoning or credentials are published here
